about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your reliable solution partner in the flooring industry
about.storyText1: Founded in Istanbul in 2005, our company has become one of the leading brands in the sector with over 20 years of experience in carpet tiles and artificial grass.
about.storyText2: Prioritizing quality and aiming to provide the best flooring solutions to our customers, our company has managed to become a reliable business partner in both corporate and individual projects.
about.missionText: To maintain the highest level of customer satisfaction by offering innovative, sustainable and aesthetic solutions in the flooring sector.
about.visionText: To reach a position recognized in international markets as Turkey's most reliable flooring brand.
